Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: Relied on and echoed DuckDuckGo’s auto-generated “Search Assist” snippet incorrectly stating that the 1927 film Education of a Prince originated from the United States, instead of verifying with authoritative sources (e.g., Wikipedia/IMDb/Silent Era) that it is a French film. This misidentification could lead to the wrong conclusion that both films are from the same country.
